question: Which divine epithets are saluted in this hymn?
premises: brahmadaṇḍavinirmātre means to creator of brahma staff
śataghnīpāśaśaktimate means to bearer of hundred-slayer noose and spear
inference: The deity is praised as creator and weapon-bearer.
plain_english: Obeisance to the creator of the brahma staff and the bearer of hundred-slayer, noose, and spear.
